source_citation: RISC-V RV32IM ISA specification (riscv.org, version 2.2); Google TPU v1 paper (Jouppi et al., ISCA 2017); NVIDIA Ampere architecture whitepaper (NVIDIA Corp., 2020); Forth standard (Forth-2012); Systolic array theory from Kung & Su (1984)
license_or_access: public (RISC-V ISA spec); published academic (TPU); public (NVIDIA whitepaper)

riscv_rv32im.name: RISC-V RV32IM (educational CPU)
riscv_rv32im.note: Educational reference; the Invention Lab IL-8 ISA is a simplified 8-bit subset for teaching

systolic_array_tpu.name: Systolic-Array Tensor Processing Unit
systolic_array_tpu.quantization: per-axis symmetric INT8 with FP32 accumulator (QDQ: Quantize → Dequantize → Quantize)
systolic_array_tpu.utilization_note: Weight-stationary dataflow achieves >85% utilization for dense GEMM when grid divides evenly into matrix dimensions
systolic_array_tpu.note: Systolic array cycles = K + 2P − 2 for a P×P tile computing C[M×N] = A[M×K]·B[K×N] with K the inner dimension

simt_gpu.name: SIMT GPU (Graphics / Compute)
simt_gpu.note: Intel Core Ultra 7 155U integrated Intel Graphics: 96 EU, 1450 MHz, LPDDR5x-7467 shared memory

forth_engine.name: Forth Engine (stack-based educational)
forth_engine.note: Stack-based Forth interpreter — matches the IL-8 CPU's OUT/IN port model

equations: systolic cycles for P×P array, K inner dim, M×N output tiles: cycles = ceil(M/P) · ceil(N/P) · (K + 2P − 2)
systolic utilization: U = (M·N·K) / (tiles · (K + 2P − 2) · P²) for dense GEMM
SIMT throughput: ops_per_cycle = SM_count · cores_per_SM · ops_per_core_per_clock
Amdahl's law: speedup = 1 / ((1 − p) + p/s) where p is the parallel fraction, s is the speedup of the parallel part
Roofline model: achievable_FLOPs = min(peak_FLOPs, arithmetic_intensity · peak_bandwidth)
Amdahl-based pipeline speedup: S_pipe = N_stages when perfectly balanced; actual = N_stages · (1 / (1 + pipeline_overhead))

systolic_tpu.note: INT8 accumulator overflow threshold: K_max for INT32 accumulator = 2^31 / (255 × 255) ≈ 33038

int32_accumulator_overflow.condition: accumulated product sum exceeds 2^31 − 1 (INT32 max) in QDQ INT8 GEMM
int32_accumulator_overflow.detection: requires per-tile saturation check in the systolic array design
int32_accumulator_overflow.mitigation: INT32 accumulator safely handles K up to 33038 for INT8 inputs (±127 × ±127 = 16129 max product per MAC)

thermal_throttle.effect: clock throttling, potential permanent damage above absolute maximum rating
